userStories.title: Add book to cart
userStories.description: As a user, I want to add a book to my shopping cart from the book details page.
acceptanceCriteria: Add to Cart button is visible
Clicking adds item to global state

userStories.title: View cart contents
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view the contents of my shopping cart to review my selected books.
acceptanceCriteria: Cart page displays list of items
Shows book title, cover, price, and quantity

userStories.title: Update or remove cart items
userStories.description: As a user, I want to update the quantity of a book in my cart or remove it entirely.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove button deletes item from cart
